Storage, by the shelf

  • Oak wall shelf

    Solid oak, hidden brackets, holds 20 kg along its length.

  • Steel pantry rack

    Five adjustable tiers in powder-coated steel, for tins and jars.

  • Stacking crates

    Three sizes of pine crate that lock together into a low bookcase.

  • Hanging rail

    A ceiling rail with eight hooks for the hallway or a shop floor.
